title: Heart of Borealis
body:
"A heart, crystallized from the love that the Borealis provides to all of Oaklands."

The Heart of Borealis can (rarely) be found anywhere in the Snowlands and Icelands biome when there's an aurora event happening (the polar lights in the sky).

Appearance

Its a crystal-heart shaped object that emits sparkles and aurora-like lines.

Usage

Besides looking very cool, it can be combined with the Icecrest Axe and Pickaxe to make them Auroracrest tools.
